title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: Basis for Correcting a Traveller's Name
content:
A misspelling of the traveller's name is corrected on an issued ticket under Air Ticket Fare Brands against the name-correction fee of the fare brand held, provided the number of characters that differ from the identity document does not exceed the character limit of that brand.

**The bases of judgement.** The correction is made against the identity document held on the traveller's profile, and never against what the caller says the spelling should be; what the caller says is the reason for looking, not the authority for what the name is. The quantity measured is the number of characters by which the name on the issued ticket differs from the name on that document.

| What the comparison shows | Result |
|---|---|
| Fewer characters differing than the limit of the brand held | A correction. The ticket is corrected against that brand's name-correction fee |
| Exactly as many characters differing as the limit of the brand held | Still a correction, the limit itself being within what the brand allows, and the ticket is corrected against that brand's name-correction fee |
| More characters differing than the limit of the brand held | Not a correction but a change of traveller, which no brand permits. The ticket is cancelled on the brand's own terms and a new ticket is sold |

**One name-correction line to a booking.** A name-correction line is raised only when no name-correction line has already been raised against the same booking. Whether one already has been is taken from the postings recorded against that booking and the reason each was posted, read before the line is raised; the postings consulted are those carried against the identifier of the booking being corrected. Postings are told apart from one another by when each was posted and by which traveller within the booking it was raised for.

**A fee of zero is still a limit.** A brand whose name-correction fee is zero still applies its character limit, because the limit is the airline's and not the agency's.

**Contact details.** Correcting the contact address or the contact number on a booking is free on every brand, and is not a name correction.
